**Royalty & Franchise‑Financing Restructuring Blueprint – 2026** **Target Markets:** Turkey, Egypt, Nigeria, Indonesia, Brazil **Scope:** 5,200 franchised outlets, 1,300 company‑owned stores --- ## 1. Executive Summary - **Challenge:** Fixed USD‑denominated royalties are eroding cash flows in high‑inflation, devaluing‑currency markets. - **Goal:** Re‑balance royalty economics so that (1) brand‑wide marketing & R&D funding is secured, (2) franchisees retain growth‑eligible cash, (3) collective‑bargaining structures remain credible, and (4) currency & inflation risk is bounded. - **Solution Overview:** 1. **Dual‑currency royalty model** using a *clamped *index‑plus‑floor* formula*. 2. **Brand‑Contribution Index (BCI)** to proportionally allocate costs between franchisee and company‑owned units. 3. **Country‑Specific Financing Hub** (CCHF) with loan, equity‑infusion, and supply‑chain funds. 4. **Governance & Decision Framework** that defines voting, veto, and dispute‑resolution. 5. **Embedded scenario analysis, risk‑management and tech architecture** to ensure transparency and compliance. --- ## 2. Market‑Specific Risks & Baselines | Country | Key Macro‑Risk | Currency Index | Inflation (2025‑26) | Collective Bargaining Maturity | |---------|----------------|----------------|--------------------|--------------------------------| | Turkey | 38 % USD‑TRY, 45 % CPI | Spot 1 USD=28 TRY (forward 3 mo 1 USD=27.5 TRY) | 45 % | High | | Egypt | 30 % USD‑EGP, 35 % CPI | Spot 1 USD=30 EGP (forward 3 mo 1 USD=29.5 EGP) | 35 % | High | | Nigeria | 25 % USD‑₦, 27 % CPI | Spot 1 USD=430 ₦ (forward 3 mo 1 USD=420 ₦) | 27 % | Emerging | | Indonesia| 12 % USD‑₩, 7 % CPI | Spot 1 USD=14 ₩ (forward 3 mo 1 USD=13.8 ₩) | 7 % | Moderate | | Brazil | 7 % USD‑BRL, 7 % CPI | Spot 1 USD=5.0 BRL (forward 3 mo 1 USD=4.9 BRL) | 7 % | High | *Source: IMF/World Bank 2024; local central bank feeds.* --- ## 3. Dual‑Currency Royalty Architecture ### 3.1 Core Formula **Royalty =  Base × [1 + Clamp( ΔUSD/Local , Floor )]** Where: | Symbol | Meaning | Calculation | |--------|---------|--------------| | **Base** | Standard royalty % on local‐currency sales for a region’s market segment | • Turkey/ Egypt: 8 %
• Nigeria: 7.5 %
• Indonesia: 7 %
• Brazil: 7.5 % | | **ΔUSD/Local** | Annual change in USD relative to the local currency (percentage) | (USDₜ / Localₜ) – (USD₀ / Local₀) | | **Floor** | Minimum rate increase mandated by the *Inflation‑Linked Cap* (see §3.5) | | **Clamp** | Limits ΔUSD/Local to the Floor if ΔUSD/Local is lower; otherwise applies ΔUSD/Local plus a 2 % safety buffer | **Example – Turkey (2025‑26)** | Variable | Value | Result | |----------|-------|--------| | Base | 8 % | 0.08 | | ΔUSD/Local | +25 % (USD depreciated 25 % vs TRY) | 0.25 | | Floor | 0.02 (2 % of base) | 0.02 | | Clamp | 0.25 (ΔUSD/Local > Floor) | 0.25 | | Final Royalty | 0.08 × (1 + 0.25) = 0.10 → 10 % of TRY sales | ### 3.2 Inflation‑Linked Cap (Tightened Boundaries) | Parameter | Value | |-----------|-------| | **Floor** | 2 % of Base (1/5 of base) | | **Cap** | Base + min( 6 % * CPI, 12 % * Local Inflation) | | **Hard Ceiling** | 12 % of local sales | *Illustration – Nigeria:* - Base = 7.5 % - CPI = 27 % → 6 % of CPI = 1.62 % - Local Inflation = 27 % → 12 % of local = 3.24 % - Cap = 0.075 + min(0.0162, 0.0324) = 0.091 = 9.1 %. - Royalty cannot exceed 9.1 % under any circumstances. ### 3.3 Brand‑Contribution Index (BCI) | Cost Driver | Allocation to Franchisee | Allocation to Company‑Owned | |-------------|---------------------------|-----------------------------| | Marketing & Advertising | 60 % | 40 % | | R&D & Product Innovation | 70 % | 30 % | | Local Compliance (licenses, inspections) | 80 % | 20 % | | Supply‑chain & logistics | 100 % | 0 % | **Result:** - **Company‑Owned Royalty** = Base × (1 + BCI% * 0.4) - **Franchisee Royalty** = Base × (1 + BCI% * 0.6) *Example – Brazil:* - Base = 7.5 % - BCI (sum of % allocations) = 0.7 (average across categories) - Company‑Owned Royalty = 7.5 % × (1 + 0.28) = 9.54 % - Franchisee Royalty = 7.5 % × (1 + 0.42) = 10.85 % - Difference (2.31 %) financed by company‑owned margin, aligning brand economics. --- ## 4. Country‑Specific Financing Hub (CCHF) | Element | Structure | Key Parameters | Funding Source | |---------|-----------|----------------|----------------| | **Loan Fund** | Syndicated 5‑yr term; interest = base risk‑adjusted (local repo) + 0.5–0.8 % spread | 3‑month amortization; 6‑month grace; collateral = franchise assets | 60 % parent equity, 40 % local bank | | **Equity Infusion** | Limited‑partnership vehicle; parent contributes 10 % of projected NOP; equity capped at 15 % of store equity | Buy‑back after 5 yrs at fair‑market value (NAV) | Parent capital, limited liability | | **Supply‑chain Credit** | Revolving line up to 35 % of weekly sales; 9 % discount on inventory | 30‑day turnover; repayment auto‑deduct | Parent procurement team | **Loan Covenant Monitoring** | Covenant | Target | Alert | Escalation | |----------|--------|-------|-----------| | EBITDA / Interest Coverage ≥ 3.0× | ≥ 3.0× | Email & SMS | 30‑day notice | | Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) ≥ 1.2× | ≥ 1.2× | Dashboard | 90‑day notice | | Asset‑to‑Liability Ratio ≤ 50 % | ≤ 50 % | Dashboard | Immediate audit | **Default Triggers** 1. > 90 days delinquency → asset valuation & 5 % penalty. 2. Unapproved sale of collateral → suspension of credit line. --- ## 5. Equity‑Infusion Governance | Stakeholder | Shareholding % | Rights | Exit | |-------------|----------------|--------|------| | Parent Equity Fund | 70 % | 1‑vot| majority voting | Buy‑back at NAV after 5 yrs | | Franchisee (in‑house) | 30 % | Share in profits, voting on operational matters | IPO or minority sale to partner after 10 yrs | *Governance diagram* (simplified): ``` [Parent Equity Fund] ----> 70% equity | v [Franchisee] ----> 30% equity | v [Operational Oversight Board] (dual‑membership) ``` --- ## 6. Brand Quality & Compliance Monitoring **Quarterly Brand‑Compliance Scorecard (BCS)** | KPI | Threshold | Action | |-----|-----------|--------| | Food‑Safety Audit Score | ≥ 95 % | No penalty | | Customer Satisfaction Index | ≥ 85 % | 2 % royalty rebate | | Inventory Turnover | ≥ 3.0× | 1 % royalty rebate | | On‑Time Delivery (%) | ≥ 98 % | 1 % royalty rebate | *Royalty Adjustment:* - **Rebate**: Upgradable up to 3 % of royalty if BCS ≥ 98 %. - **Penalty**: 1 % royalty surcharge if BCS ≤ 80 % for two consecutive quarters. Audit Verification: Third‑party auditors with audit‑trailing evidence; 30 % random sampling of sales invoices. --- ## 7. Technology Stack & Data Governance | Layer | Function | Integration | Privacy Compliance | |-------|----------|-------------|--------------------| | **ERP Core** | Financials, royalty calculations, KPI reporting | APIs to POS, accounting, CRM | GDPR (EU), POPIA (South Africa) | | **POS & Mobile** | Sales capture, currency conversion | Real‑time POS sync to ERP | PCI‑DSS compliant | | **Data Lake** | Historical data, predictive analytics | Secure connectors to weather, satellite feeds | GDPR‑aware data residency | | **Dashboard** | Royalty & compliance dashboards, real‑time alerts | Business‑intelligence (PowerBI/Looker) | Role‑based access, MFA | | **Smart Contract Ledger** | Royalty escrow, anti‑fraud settlement | Blockchain‑based (Hyperledger) | Immutable audit trail | **Data Privacy Controls** 1. Data minimization – only essential fields captured. 2. Encryption at rest & in transit. 3. Data‑subject access requests (DSAR) automated. --- ## 8. Currency Risk Management Policy | Instrument | Maturity | Hedge Ratio | Collateral | Adjusted Window | |------------|----------|------------|------------|-----------------| | Spot + 30‑day forward | 30 days | 60 % of expected royalty | Franchise property | 15‑days | | Monthly cross‑hair rebalance | 30 days | 100 % of spot | None | 7‑day | | **Cap** on FX moves | N/A | N/A | N/A | 2 % of base royalty | *Scenario:* 30 % USD depreciation → royalty rise capped to 12 % (hard ceiling). --- ## 9. Scenario Analysis (Sensitivity Matrix) | Country | Scenario | Royalty % | Royalty / Sales (USD) | |---------|----------|-----------|------------------------| | Turkey | 30 % USD depreciation, 20 % CPI | 10.2 % | 10.2 % of TRY sales | | Egypt | 25 % USD depreciation, 10 % CPI | 9.8 % | 9.8 % of EGP sales | | Nigeria | 20 % USD depreciation, 27 % CPI | 9.0 % | 9.0 % of ₦ sales | | Indonesia | 5 % USD depreciation, 7 % CPI | 7.2 % | 7.2 % of ₩ sales | | Brazil | 5 % USD depreciation, 7 % CPI | 9.0 % | 9.0 % of BRL sales | *Interpretation:* Even in worst‑case scenarios, royalty rates remain below 12 %—the hard ceiling. --- ## 10. Governance & Decision‑Making | Body | Membership | Voting Threshold | Special Powers | |------|------------|-------------------|----------------| | **Royalty Review Committee (RRC)** | 1 FA rep per 25 outlets + 1 franchisee rep per 5 outlets + 1 franchisor senior exec | 60 % of votes, with a ‘super‑majority 70 %’ needed for cap adjustments | Veto on any royalty increase > 3 % beyond Base | | **Franchisee Association Board (FAB)** | Representations from all FA chairs | Majority (50 %) | Approve annual licensing terms | | **Conflict‑Resolution Panel (CRP)** | Third‑party mediator (IFC/IFRA) | 100 % agreement | Arbitrates disputes within 45 days | **Escalation Path** 1. RRC meeting – resolve on‑issue. 2. If unresolved, submit to CRP (public‑recorded hearing). 3. Final appeal to parent’s Legal & Risk Committee (max 90 days). --- ## 11. Risk Management & Contingencies | Category | Risk | Mitigation | Escalation | |----------|------|------------|------------| | Currency | USD depreciation > 30 % | FX hedging policy; cap at 12 % | CRP | | Inflation | CPI > 25 % | Inflation‑linked floor & cap | RRC | | Fraud | Over‑reporting sales | Audit trail, AI fraud scoring | CRP | | Legal | Withholding tax change | Continuous tax monitoring; local counsel | Legal | | Credit | Loan default | Covenant monitoring, secured collateral | CRP | --- ## 12. Exit / Roll‑back Clause - **Trigger:** Local inflation remains < 5 % for ≥ 12 months. - **Action:** Franchisee may elect a fixed USD royalty (same rate as 2024) for that fiscal year, subject to 5 % transition fee. - **Roll‑back Procedure:** 1. Franchisee submits application 3 months prior. 2. RRC reviews market conditions. 3. If approved, new rate effective 1 Jan of next year. --- ## 13. Implementation Roadmap (18‑Months) | Phase | Duration | Milestone | Key Output | Resources | KPI | |-------|----------|-----------|------------|-----------|-----| | **Phase 1 – Design** | 0–2 months | Finalize formula, BCI matrix, legal compliance table | Decision‑matrix | 2 legal, 1 finance, 1 risk head | Decision‑approval | | **Phase 2 – Pilot** | 3–5 months | Deploy in 4 outlets per country (12 total) | Pilot ROI | 1 country manager per country, 2 IT devs | Royalty compliance ≥ 90 % | | **Phase 3 – Data Integration** | 6–8 months | Connect POS → ERP → Dashboard | Operational data flows | 3 IT ops (including data scientists) | Data integrity ≥ 99 % | | **Phase 4 – Governance Setup** | 9–10 months | RRC and FAB formed, voting rules codified | Charter documents | 1 legal, 1 risk, 1 HR | 100 % of FA signed | | **Phase 5 – Scale‑Up** | 11–14 months | Roll‑out to 70 % of outlets | New royalty contracts | 5 country managers, 2 finance | Royalty compliance ≥ 95 % | | **Phase 6 – Optimization** | 15–18 months | Adjust cap, rebate thresholds, financing terms | Updated policy | 1 finance, 1 risk | KPI: NPV > 10 % | **Budget Snapshot** - IT infrastructure & dashboard: $500 k - Legal & compliance: $200 k - Training & change‑management: $150 k - Contingency (10 % of total): $90 k **Total:** $940 k (capable of scaling to full portfolio within 2 yr). --- ## 14. Conclusion & Next Steps 1. **Finalize** and sign off on the dual‑currency royalty formula & BCI allocation. 2. **Secure** parent‑company credit lines for the CCHF and align with local banks. 3. **Launch** pilot in Turkey, Egypt, and Brazil (most mature FAs) before scaling to Nigeria and Indonesia. 4. **Deploy** the real‑time dashboard and data‑governance framework. 5. **Institutionalise** RRC & FAB governance structures with formal voting protocols. By incorporating rigorous, market‑specific calculations, precise governance, and transparent risk controls, this blueprint transforms the legacy royalty model into a resilient, equity‑fair, and data‑driven framework fit for the diverse economics of the five target markets.
